title: One model distilled from the router
why: The router (two models chosen per tile) scores 80-85% but costs two networks; telling one network the tile flag (faces-v12) didn't reproduce it (65-67%). Instead, train one network to copy the router's answers on every pixel of the real training maps.
changes: Real maps labelled by the router teacher (faces-v7 on clear-cut tiles, faces-v4 elsewhere), weighted by its confidence, instead of by the rule
